notes: ADS8694 CONTRADICTION (board vs p26/p28): board REFSEL (pin 3) net is R125.1 with R125.2 to GND (1k), i.e. low; p26: "In order to select the internal reference, the REFSEL pin must be tied low or connected to AGND." while REFIO (pin 5) is on net Net-(C122-Pad1) shared with U30.6/7 (LTC6655-4.096, pin function not checked here). p28: external mode needs "either tie the REFSEL pin high or connect this pin to the DVDD supply." Check intent in the schematic. Figures: Fig 57 p26 (internal ref) vs Fig 62 p28 (external ref); both show 1 uF + 22 uF on REFCAP.
ADS8694 p66 asks for 10uF and 1uF per AVDD supply; p67 names only the 1uF as the close one. C121 board 22uF is 0603, datasheet says 1210.
ADS8694 p67: "Placing vias between the AVDD, DVDD pins and the bypass capacitors must be avoided." Board C120/C121/C122 are on B.Cu and U29 on F.Cu, so a via is unavoidable unless moved to F.Cu.
PMA2 Fig 1 caps C1/C2 are 1000pF 0402; board C98/C99/C108/C109 are 100pF 0603. Datasheet Fig 1 is the characterization test circuit (TB-805+), not a layout.
LMX2541 OSCin*: p57 "terminated the same as the OSCin pin" (Fig 34 shows 0.1 uF + 50 ohm on each); board pin 22 net has only R10 50R5 to GND, no series cap.
LMX2541 loop filter: board R13 4K7 vs Table 19 R2_LF 470 ohm (the example is a 4000.25 MHz/100 MHz design; WEBENCH sets the values).
Board positions in fixed.kicad_pcb are not final placement (support parts are 5-17 mm from the pins); gaps were not used for max_mm.
Values read off figure labels (Fig 32, Fig 112) were read from page images; pdftotext garbles the units (µ shows as P).
